name: Wall-Slide Squat Jumps
description: Stand with heels and back 2 inches off a flat wall. Drop into a quarter squat, swing arms back, and jump straight up while reaching both arms overhead. Keep the movement vertical. Practice with your coach and adequate clearance.

name: Depth Drop-to-Vertical Rebound
description: With your coach, step off a low box. Land on the balls of your feet with a controlled soft bend, then rebound straight up and reach overhead. Keep the landing controlled and contact brief.

name: Supine Rapid Tuck Snaps
description: Lie in a hollow hold, lower back on the mat and heels hovering. Quickly bring your knees toward your armpits and hold your shins in a tight ball for one count. Open back to hollow without resting your heels.

name: Tuck Roll to Horizontal Kickout Freeze
target: Opening the tuck into a straight entry line
description: Roll onto your shoulders in a tight tuck. As you roll forward, extend your legs parallel to the floor, hovering 2–4 inches above the mat. Reach arms overhead into an entry position and hold a rigid line for two seconds.

name: Belly-to-Wall Handstand Lineup
target: Entry line past vertical or off vertical
description: With a coach or spotter, enter a belly-to-wall handstand with hands 4–6 inches away. Keep pointed toes lightly at the wall, draw your abdomen and hips into line, and push tall through your shoulders with ears between your arms.

name: Box jumps
description: Swing the arms and jump onto the box, reaching full hip and knee extension before landing softly. Step down between reps.

name: Squat jumps with arm swing
description: Sink to a quarter squat with arms back, then drive the arms up past the ears as you jump, finishing tall with pointed toes.

name: Single-leg calf raises
description: From the edge of a step, lower the heel below the step then rise as high as possible onto the ball of the foot. Slow down, fast up.

name: Single-leg glute bridges
description: Lying on your back with one foot planted, drive the hips up until knee, hip and shoulder form a straight line. Squeeze for two seconds at the top.

name: Dryland hurdle to takeoff
equipment: Line on the floor or a low mat
description: Take two steps, hurdle to a two-foot landing on a line with arms circling up, and jump straight up without drifting forward. Land where you took off.

name: Arm swing timing jumps
description: Stand tall, circle the arms down and back up, and time the jump so the arms reach overhead exactly as the feet leave the floor.

name: Standing jumps to a target line
description: Place a line about 60 cm in front of your toes. Jump up and slightly forward to land on it, keeping the chest up. Adjust the line until the height and distance feel right.

name: V-ups
description: From lying flat with arms overhead, lift straight legs and chest together to touch the toes at the top, then lower with control.

name: Hanging knee raises
description: Hang from a bar and pull the knees up to the chest as tight as you can, pausing at the top as if grabbing the shins in a tuck.

name: Tuck snaps
description: Lying on your back, snap from a straight hollow position into a tight tuck, grabbing the shins with heels to the seat, then extend back out. Make the snap fast.

name: Seated pike compression lifts
description: Sit in a pike with straight legs and hands beside the knees. Lift both heels off the floor by pulling the legs toward the chest, keeping the knees locked.

name: Seated pike stretch
description: Sit with legs together and straight, toes pointed, and fold forward from the hips with a flat back. Keep the knees pressed down.

name: Straight-leg raises
description: Lying on your back, raise locked, pointed legs to vertical and lower slowly without the lower back arching.

name: Hollow body hold
description: Lie on your back, press the lower back into the floor, and lift arms, shoulders and straight legs a few centimetres. Keep the feet squeezed together.

name: Superman arch hold
description: Lie face down and lift arms and legs together with glutes squeezed, keeping the arms by the ears and legs straight.

name: Front plank with posterior tilt
description: Hold a plank on the forearms while tucking the pelvis under and squeezing the glutes, so the body is one straight line from head to heels.

name: Wall handstand hold
equipment: Wall, with a spotter if new to handstands
description: Chest to the wall, hands shoulder width, arms locked by the ears and toes pointed. Feel what a truly vertical line is: this is the shape you want at entry.

name: Streamline wall sit
description: In a wall sit, press the back of the hands and arms up the wall in a tight streamline, squeezing the head between the arms.

name: Flat-hand grab presses
description: Hold the stick overhead with the flat-hand grab (one palm over the back of the other hand) and press to full lockout, ears squeezed between the arms. Hold two seconds each rep.

name: Ball squeeze holds
description: Lying on your back with straight legs raised, squeeze a ball between the ankles as hard as you can while keeping the toes pointed.

name: Dryland somersaults to a straight finish
equipment: Trampoline or crash mat, with a coach
description: Practise the somersault in the dive's position and open to a straight line on cue. Only do this on proper equipment with a coach spotting.

name: Line-up spotting drill
description: From a standing fall or a low forward roll on the mat, pick a fixed spot and extend into a straight line exactly when you see it, to train the timing of the come-out.
